title: Trait default stubs unused: preferred_digest_algorithm and supported_key_enc_algorithm
description: preferred_digest_algorithm() and supported_key_enc_algorithm() are declared as default methods on SigningKey and DecryptionKey respectively, with doc comments saying 'Implementations may override to enable algorithm negotiation.' However, grep confirms neither method is called anywhere in sign.rs, decrypt.rs, or any tests. sign.rs explicitly hardcodes SHA-256 and ignores the key's preference. decrypt.rs never consults supported_key_enc_algorithm() before trying to decrypt. These stubs are dead API surface: they promise extensibility that the library itself does not honour. Every future maintainer who reads the trait will wonder why the hint is never consulted, and any implementor who overrides them will see no effect. Maintenance consequence: creates confusion for trait implementors, implies false extensibility, and must be either wired up or removed before the 1.0 API freeze.
close_reason: doc clarified: stubs are caller extension points, not consumed by this crate internally
